metadata.description: Agent skills distilled from real-world usage: implementation-loop — delegate implementation to Codex while keeping review, test-gating, and shipping judgment in Claude's hands; web-slides — click-driven 16:9 HTML slide decks with a presenter view for live presenting. engineering-mode — goal-first investigation, design, planning, and verified implementation.

plugins.name: implementation-loop
plugins.description: A review-gated implementation loop: dispatch coding units to Codex through pinned plain codex exec, review the diff, iterate with loop-owned state, gate on the full test suite, then ship as a PR. Encodes hard-won environment constraints (read-only git, no full-suite runs, stuck-job handling) and seven user-configurable dials.

plugins.name: web-slides
plugins.description: Turn material, outlines, or talking points into click-driven 16:9 HTML slide decks for live presenting — cinematic, anti-AI aesthetic, 24 built-in themes, per-step speaker notes, and a presenter view (press P: speaker notes + live slide preview + timer in a separate window, synced via BroadcastChannel — share only the slide window to hide notes from the audience). Ships a Vite + React + TypeScript scaffold. Derived from ConardLi's garden-skills (MIT).

plugins.name: engineering-mode
plugins.description: Goal-first engineering ownership — investigate, root-cause, design, plan, then delegate implementation unit-by-unit to implementation-loop, with honest artifact-level verification. Requires the implementation-loop plugin plus an authenticated backend CLI.
